disclaimer: This comprehensive catalog is for general educational awareness regarding widely available over-the-counter (OTC) supportive remedies. It does NOT constitute a personalized prescription, diagnosis, or clinical advice. Never administer medications to infants or children without consulting a registered pediatrician. Always read the package leaflet and consult a licensed doctor or pharmacist.
notice: All medicines listed are non-prescription OTC supportive options only. No prescription-only medicines (POM) or controlled antibiotics are included. Always verify packaging instructions and contraindications.

fever.name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen 500mg/650mg)
fever.purpose: Reduces elevated body temperature (antipyretic) and relieves general pain, headache, and body aches.
fever.general_info: First-line over-the-counter antipyretic and analgesic. Acts centrally on hypothalamic thermoregulation centers. Available in tablets, syrup, and drops.
precautions: Do not exceed maximum daily adult dose (4000 mg in 24 hours from all combined sources).
Maintain an interval of at least 4 to 6 hours between consecutive doses.
Check labels of all multi-symptom cold medications to avoid accidental paracetamol overdose.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity or allergic reaction to paracetamol.
Severe active liver failure, acute hepatitis, or advanced cirrhosis.
Chronic severe alcohol dependency.
fever.safety_note: First choice antipyretic. Always consult a pediatrician for age-appropriate dosage in children.
fever.dosage_guide: Adults: 500mg - 650mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 4000mg in 24 hours.

serious: Swelling of lips, tongue or face
side_effects.management: Take with a glass of water, with or without food. Never combine with other paracetamol-containing cold medicines. If allergic rash occurs, stop immediately.

fever.name: Ibuprofen (200mg / 400mg)
fever.purpose: Lowers high fever and relieves inflammatory body aches, joint stiffness, and muscle pains.
fever.general_info: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that inhibits prostaglandin synthesis, reducing both fever and localized tissue swelling.
precautions: Always take with or immediately following a meal or glass of milk to protect gastric lining.
Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration necessary.
Maintain adequate oral fluid intake to support kidney function.
avoid_if: Active peptic ulcer disease, history of gastrointestinal bleeding, or severe gastritis.
Severe renal (kidney) failure or advanced heart failure.
Third trimester of pregnancy.
Aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease (aspirin-sensitive asthma).
fever.safety_note: Avoid combining with other NSAIDs (such as naproxen, diclofenac, or aspirin).
fever.dosage_guide: Adults: 200mg - 400mg every 6 to 8 hours with or after food. Maximum 1200mg/day OTC.

side_effects.management: Always take strictly with meals or a glass of milk to protect stomach lining. Discontinue immediately if stomach burning or black stools occur.

fever.name: Mefenamic Acid (250mg / 500mg)
fever.purpose: Relieves acute fever and severe spasmodic body pain, toothache, or muscle aches.
fever.general_info: Potent NSAID with analgesic and antipyretic properties, especially effective for fever accompanied by muscular cramping or dysmenorrhea.
precautions: Take strictly after food to reduce stomach upset.
Limit use to short courses (under 5 to 7 days) unless prescribed otherwise by a physician.
Keep hydrated throughout the day.
avoid_if: Active gastrointestinal ulceration or inflammatory bowel disease.
Severe kidney or liver impairment.
Pregnancy, especially in the third trimester.
fever.safety_note: Discontinue immediately if heartburn, dark tarry stools, or severe stomach pain develops.
fever.dosage_guide: Adults: 250mg - 500mg up to 3 times daily after food. Short duration use only (under 5 days).

side_effects.management: Consume immediately after a substantial meal. Do not use for more than 5 consecutive days without physician advice.

fever.name: Lukewarm Sponge Hydrotherapy
fever.purpose: Non-pharmacological physical cooling to safely bring down elevated surface body temperature.
fever.general_info: Gentle wiping of forehead, neck, armpits, and groin using a soft cloth moistened with comfortably lukewarm water (around 30°C / 85°F).
precautions: Always use lukewarm tap water, NEVER ice water or cold alcohol rubs.
Stop sponging if the patient begins shivering, as shivering increases internal core temperature.
Keep the room well-ventilated without direct cold drafts.
avoid_if: Shivering, severe chills, or hypothermia.
Uncooperative or highly agitated individuals.
fever.safety_note: An excellent drug-free adjunctive measure, especially in children while waiting for oral antipyretics to take effect.
fever.dosage_guide: Apply lukewarm (not cold) damp cloth to forehead, neck, armpits for 15-20 minutes.

common: Transient shivering if water is too cold
serious: Hypothermic shivering (if ice water is mistakenly used)
side_effects.management: Ensure water is lukewarm (around 30°C / 85°F). Stop immediately if the patient begins shivering.

fever.name: Oral Electrolyte Rehydration Fluid
fever.purpose: Prevents dehydration and replaces essential sodium, potassium, and chloride lost through fever sweating.
fever.general_info: Balanced electrolyte formulation restoring water and mineral balance caused by prolonged perspiration and fever-related metabolic demands.
precautions: Mix with clean drinking water as per package directions.
Sip small amounts regularly every 15 to 30 minutes.
Do not boil ready-made pre-mixed electrolyte solutions.
avoid_if: Severe persistent vomiting requiring intravenous fluids.
Anuria or severe kidney failure without medical clearance.
fever.safety_note: Crucial supportive therapy for prolonged fever to prevent weakness and orthostatic lightheadedness.
fever.dosage_guide: Dissolve 1 sachet in exactly 1 liter of clean drinking water. Sip 200-400ml after each fever spike or loose motion.

serious: Fluid overload or puffy eyes if mixed too concentrated with inadequate water
side_effects.management: Mix with the exact recommended water quantity. Do not add extra sugar, salt, or boiling water.

cold_cough.name: Steam Inhalation Therapy
cold_cough.purpose: Moistens mucosal airway lining, loosens thick phlegm, and unblocks congested nasal sinuses.
cold_cough.general_info: Natural physical therapy using warm water vapor to soothe irritated upper respiratory tracts and facilitate sinus drainage.
precautions: Keep face at a safe distance (25-30 cm) from the hot water surface to avoid scalding burns.
Keep hot containers and electrical steamers completely away from young children.
Inhale steadily for 5 to 10 minutes, 2 to 3 times daily.
avoid_if: Unsupervised young children.
Severe reactive bronchospasm or acute asthma attacks triggered by warm vapor.
cold_cough.safety_note: Plain water steam is safest. Avoid adding concentrated essential oils which can trigger bronchial irritation.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: Inhale warm plain steam for 5 to 10 minutes, 2 to 3 times daily from 25-30cm safe distance.

serious: Scalding burns if container tips over
Bronchospasm if strong aromatic additives used
side_effects.management: Use plain water only. Keep hot steam unit on a stable surface far out of children's reach.

cold_cough.name: Saline Nasal Drops / Spray (0.9% NaCl)
cold_cough.purpose: Gently washes out allergens, thins sticky mucus, and restores natural nasal ciliary motion.
cold_cough.general_info: Sterile isotonic salt solution that cleanses nasal passages without chemicals, drugs, or preservatives.
precautions: Do not share droppers or nozzles across family members to prevent spreading viruses.
Gently blow nose a few minutes after application.
Discard open bottles according to expiry guidance.
avoid_if: Severe nasal trauma or suspected skull base injury.
cold_cough.safety_note: Completely safe for daily use; does not cause rebound nasal congestion.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: 2 to 3 drops or 1-2 sprays into each nostril 3 to 4 times daily as needed.

serious: None reported with sterile isotonic saline
side_effects.management: Blow nose gently 2-3 minutes after application. Wipe nozzle clean and never share spray bottles.

cold_cough.name: Cetirizine (10mg)
cold_cough.purpose: Relieves sneezing, runny nose, itchy watery eyes, and allergic nasal flare-ups.
cold_cough.general_info: Second-generation H1-antihistamine providing 24-hour relief with lower sedation compared to first-generation options.
precautions: Preferably take once daily at bedtime as mild drowsiness can occur.
Avoid operating heavy machinery or driving until you know how the medication affects you.
Avoid concurrent alcohol consumption.
avoid_if: Severe end-stage renal disease (eGFR < 10 ml/min).
Known hypersensitivity to cetirizine or hydroxyzine.
cold_cough.safety_note: Highly effective for acute seasonal allergic rhinitis and histamine-driven runny nose.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: Adults: 10mg once daily, preferably at bedtime with a glass of water.

side_effects.management: Take at night to avoid daytime grogginess. Do not drive or consume alcohol while on this medication.

cold_cough.name: Loratadine (10mg)
cold_cough.purpose: Provides non-drowsy 24-hour relief from nasal congestion, sneezing, and runny nose.
cold_cough.general_info: Non-sedating second-generation antihistamine suitable for daytime symptom control during work or school.
precautions: Take once daily with or without food.
Adhere to recommended daily dosage limits.
avoid_if: Severe hepatic impairment unless dosage adjusted by doctor.
Known hypersensitivity to loratadine.
cold_cough.safety_note: Ideal choice for daytime allergic cold symptoms where alertness is required.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: Adults: 10mg once daily in the morning with or without food.

side_effects.management: Ideal for daytime use. Stay hydrated by sipping water throughout the day.

cold_cough.name: Dextromethorphan HBr (Syrup / Lozenges)
cold_cough.purpose: Suppresses dry, tickly, non-productive hacking coughs that disturb rest and sleep.
cold_cough.general_info: Centrally acting cough suppressant that elevates the cough threshold in the brain's medulla without suppressing respiration.
precautions: Do not use for productive wet coughs where clearing mucus is medically necessary.
Always use the provided measuring cup or syringe.
Do not combine with other multi-symptom cold syrups without verifying ingredients.
avoid_if: Concurrent use with monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) or within 14 days of stopping them.
Chronic bronchitis, emphysema, or wet mucus-filled productive cough.
cold_cough.safety_note: Reserved specifically for non-productive dry coughs.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: Adults: 10ml (15mg-30mg) every 6 to 8 hours for dry hacking cough. Max 120mg/day.

serious: Serotonin syndrome if combined with MAOI antidepressants
side_effects.management: Only use for non-productive dry cough. Do NOT use if coughing up thick green/yellow phlegm.

cold_cough.name: Guaifenesin Expectorant (Syrup)
cold_cough.purpose: Thins and loosens viscous phlegm, making wet chesty coughs more productive and easier to clear.
cold_cough.general_info: Oral expectorant that increases hydration of respiratory tract secretions, reducing mucus viscosity.
precautions: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to assist the mucus-thinning effect.
Follow package dosage guidelines carefully.
avoid_if: Known allergy to guaifenesin or syrup inactive excipients.
Children under 4 years without pediatrician supervision.
cold_cough.safety_note: Hydration is key: drinking warm water significantly enhances guaifenesin's mucus-clearing efficacy.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: Adults: 200mg - 400mg (10ml-20ml) every 4 hours with a full glass of water. Max 2400mg/day.

side_effects.management: Drink plenty of warm fluids; hydration significantly enhances guaifenesin's mucus-thinning effect.

cold_cough.name: Chlorpheniramine Maleate (CPM 4mg)
cold_cough.purpose: Provides rapid relief from acute profuse watery runny nose, sneezing, and itchy throat.
cold_cough.general_info: First-generation antihistamine with anticholinergic properties that effectively dries up excessive nasal secretions.
precautions: Causes noticeable drowsiness; best taken at bedtime.
Do not drive or operate dangerous equipment after taking CPM.
Avoid alcohol and tranquilizers.
avoid_if: Narrow-angle glaucoma.
Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) with urinary retention.
Severe asthma exacerbation.
cold_cough.safety_note: Very effective for drying excessive nasal drip, but causes sedation.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: Adults: 4mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Maximum 24mg in 24 hours.

side_effects.management: Strictly avoid driving or operating machinery. Best taken before sleep.

cold_cough.name: Xylometazoline 0.1% Nasal Spray
cold_cough.purpose: Quickly unblocks severely stuffed nasal passages, opening airways within 2 to 3 minutes.
cold_cough.general_info: Topical alpha-adrenergic sympathomimetic nasal spray that constricts dilated nasal mucosal blood vessels.
precautions: STRICT LIMIT: Do not use for more than 3 to 5 consecutive days to prevent rhinitis medicamentosa (severe rebound congestion).
Administer 1 spray per nostril up to 2-3 times daily.
Clean nozzle after each use.
avoid_if: Uncontrolled severe hypertension or coronary artery disease.
History of trans-sphenoidal hypophysectomy or dry rhinitis.
Young children under 6 years (use pediatric strength 0.05% under doctor advice).
cold_cough.safety_note: For short-term emergency unblocking only; never use continuously for prolonged periods.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: 1 spray into each nostril 2 to 3 times daily. Maximum 3 to 5 consecutive days only.

serious: Rebound congestion (rhinitis medicamentosa) if used over 5 days
side_effects.management: Strictly limit use to maximum 5 consecutive days to prevent severe rebound nasal blockage.

cold_cough.name: Honey & Ginger Warm Demulcent
cold_cough.purpose: Natural soothing home demulcent coating irritated pharyngeal lining and calming reflex cough bursts.
cold_cough.general_info: Traditional supportive drink made with pure honey, fresh ginger extract, and warm water.
precautions: Ensure fluid is comfortably warm, not boiling.
Maintain good dental hygiene after consuming sweet mixtures.
avoid_if: Infants under 12 months of age (STRICT CONTRAINDICATION: risk of infant botulism).
cold_cough.safety_note: Supported by WHO guidelines as an effective home demulcent for cough relief in adults and children older than 1 year.
cold_cough.dosage_guide: 1-2 teaspoons of warm honey-ginger extract 3 to 4 times daily as needed.

serious: Infant botulism risk (NEVER give honey to infants under 12 months)
side_effects.management: Completely safe for adults and children over 1 year. Sip slowly to coat and soothe throat walls.

headache.name: Paracetamol (500mg / 650mg)
headache.purpose: Relieves mild to moderate tension headaches, dull aches, and stress-induced cranial discomfort.
headache.general_info: First-line pain reliever that works centrally without irritating the stomach lining or affecting blood clotting.
precautions: Do not exceed 4000 mg within a 24-hour period.
Avoid frequent daily use (more than 15 days/month) to prevent medication overuse headache.
Ensure at least 4 to 6 hours between doses.
avoid_if: Active liver disease or hepatic failure.
Known hypersensitivity to paracetamol.
Heavy alcohol consumption.
headache.safety_note: Gentle on the stomach; ideal for patients with acid reflux or gastritis.
headache.dosage_guide: Adults: 1 tablet (500-650mg) every 4-6 hours with water. Max 4000mg/day.

common: Headache recurrence if overused (medication overuse headache)
serious: Liver damage if taken with alcohol or overdosed
side_effects.management: Take with water. Limit painkiller usage to under 10 days per month to avoid rebound headaches.

headache.name: Ibuprofen (400mg)
headache.purpose: Relieves throbbing tension headaches, sinus headaches with facial pressure, and neck stiffness.
headache.general_info: NSAID that reduces prostaglandin-mediated vascular inflammation and muscular tension surrounding the scalp.
precautions: Always take with food or milk to prevent stomach irritation.
Stay well hydrated while taking NSAIDs.
avoid_if: Active stomach ulcers or history of GI bleeding.
Severe renal dysfunction.
Third trimester of pregnancy.
Aspirin-sensitive asthma.
headache.safety_note: Provides fast relief for inflammatory or sinus-associated headaches.
headache.dosage_guide: Adults: 400mg once or twice daily after food. Max 1200mg/day OTC.

side_effects.management: Always ingest with food or milk. Avoid if you have a history of gastritis or acid reflux.

headache.name: Aspirin + Paracetamol + Caffeine Combination
headache.purpose: Synergistic OTC formula targeting stubborn acute vascular headaches and migraine flare-ups.
headache.general_info: Caffeine acts as a cranial vasoconstrictor and accelerates the analgesic absorption of paracetamol and aspirin.
precautions: Take with food and a full glass of water.
Limit caffeine intake from tea or coffee while taking this medication.
Do not take close to bedtime if sensitive to caffeine.
avoid_if: Children and adolescents under 18 years with viral illness (STRICT CONTRAINDICATION: risk of Reye's syndrome).
Active stomach ulcers, bleeding disorders, or anticoagulant use.
Severe uncontrolled hypertension.
headache.safety_note: Do not give to children or teenagers recovering from chickenpox or flu symptoms.
headache.dosage_guide: Adults: 1 tablet with a full glass of water. Do not repeat sooner than 6 hours.

side_effects.management: Avoid additional coffee, tea, or energy drinks while taking this medication. Never give to children/teens.

headache.name: Peppermint & Menthol Essential Oil Roll-On
headache.purpose: Topical cooling relief providing soothing sensory diversion and easing forehead tension.
headache.general_info: Natural menthol formulation applied topically across temples and forehead to produce a gentle cooling, muscle-relaxing sensation.
precautions: Apply only to intact skin; keep strictly away from eyes, eyelids, and open wounds.
Wash hands thoroughly after application.
Test on a small patch of skin first if prone to skin sensitivity.
avoid_if: Broken, inflamed, or eczematous skin on the face.
Known allergy to menthol or peppermint oil.
headache.safety_note: Safe, non-pharmacological topical therapy for tension headaches.
headache.dosage_guide: Apply gently across forehead and temples. Keep away from eyes.

serious: Eye irritation if touched with fingers after application
side_effects.management: Wash hands thoroughly after applying. Keep strictly away from eyes, nostrils, and broken skin.

headache.name: Magnesium Glycinate / Citrate (250mg)
headache.purpose: Supportive dietary mineral helping reduce neuromuscular excitability and frequency of tension headaches.
headache.general_info: Essential intracellular cation involved in vascular tone regulation and neurotransmitter release.
precautions: Take with meals to prevent mild laxative effects.
Consult doctor if taking concurrent blood pressure medications.
avoid_if: Severe renal impairment (risk of hypermagnesemia).
Heart block or severe bradycardia.
headache.safety_note: A beneficial supportive nutritional supplement for recurrent stress and tension headaches.
headache.dosage_guide: Adults: 250mg - 350mg once daily with evening meal.

common: Mild loose stools or soft bowel movements
side_effects.management: Take with dinner to minimize bowel loosening and enhance muscle relaxation for sleep.

sore_throat.name: Warm Saline Gargle
sore_throat.purpose: Reduces pharyngeal mucosal edema, cleanses accumulated mucus, and provides drug-free pain relief.
sore_throat.general_info: Simple hypertonic/isotonic home rinse prepared with 1/2 teaspoon of salt dissolved in 200 ml of comfortably warm water.
precautions: Ensure water temperature is comfortably warm, never hot enough to scald.
Gargle for 20-30 seconds in the back of throat and spit out completely; do not swallow.
Repeat 3 to 4 times daily.
avoid_if: Young children who cannot spit reliably.
Severe swallowing impairment.
sore_throat.safety_note: Highly effective, universally recommended supportive measure for throat irritation.
sore_throat.dosage_guide: Dissolve 1/2 teaspoon table salt in 1 glass of warm water. Gargle for 30 seconds, 3-4 times daily.

serious: Nausea if swallowed in large quantities
side_effects.management: Always spit out the gargle solution completely; do not swallow.

sore_throat.name: Antiseptic Throat Lozenges (Amylmetacresol & Dichlorobenzyl Alcohol)
sore_throat.purpose: Dual-action antiseptic pastilles that soothe raw throat tissues and reduce oral bacterial count.
sore_throat.general_info: Slowly dissolvable pastilles containing antimicrobial agents that combat localized throat pathogens while stimulating salivation.
precautions: Dissolve slowly in the mouth without chewing or biting.
Do not exceed recommended lozenge count per 24 hours (typically max 8-12).
Check sugar content if diabetic.
avoid_if: Children under 6 years due to choking hazard.
Known allergy to excipients or colorings.
sore_throat.safety_note: Provides soothing symptomatic relief for early scratchy throat discomfort.
sore_throat.dosage_guide: Dissolve 1 lozenge slowly in the mouth every 2 to 3 hours as needed. Max 8-12 per day.

side_effects.management: Allow to dissolve slowly in the mouth without chewing or swallowing whole.

sore_throat.name: Povidone-Iodine 0.5% - 1% Gargle & Rinse
sore_throat.purpose: Broad-spectrum antiseptic mouthwash targeting oral bacteria, fungi, and enveloped viruses.
sore_throat.general_info: Diluted microbicidal povidone-iodine solution formulated specifically for oral pharyngeal hygiene during infections.
precautions: Dilute with an equal volume of warm water if indicated on package.
Gargle and spit out thoroughly; do NOT swallow.
Use for up to 7-10 consecutive days.
avoid_if: Known allergy to iodine or povidone.
Hyperthyroidism, active thyroid disorders, or radioactive iodine treatment.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding (avoid prolonged gargling due to systemic iodine absorption).
sore_throat.safety_note: Potent antimicrobial gargle for acute inflamed throat conditions.
sore_throat.dosage_guide: Dilute with equal parts warm water. Gargle for 30 seconds and spit out, twice daily.

common: Temporary brown staining of tongue (washes off)
side_effects.management: Spit out thoroughly after gargling. Do not use for more than 7 days or if allergic to iodine.

sore_throat.name: Benzocaine / Lidocaine Throat Spray
sore_throat.purpose: Provides rapid localized numbness to relieve severe throat pain, making swallowing and eating comfortable.
sore_throat.general_info: Topical local anesthetic spray that reversibly blocks nerve impulses in the pharyngeal mucosa.
precautions: Spray directly toward the back of the mouth as directed on packaging.
Wait at least 30-45 minutes before eating or drinking hot fluids to avoid accidental choking or tongue biting.
Use only as needed for acute pain peaks.
avoid_if: History of methemoglobinemia (associated with excessive benzocaine).
Children under 2 years.
Severe dysphagia or impaired airway reflexes.
sore_throat.safety_note: Provides fast temporary numbness for sharp swallowing pain.
sore_throat.dosage_guide: 1-2 sprays directly towards back of throat. Wait at least 2 hours before repeating.

common: Marked numbness of throat and tongue
serious: Difficulty swallowing leading to choking on food
side_effects.management: Do not eat or drink hot liquids for 1 hour after spraying to avoid biting tongue or choking.

sore_throat.name: Chlorhexidine Gluconate 0.2% Oral Rinse
sore_throat.purpose: Antiseptic oral mouthwash reducing plaque and secondary microbial contamination in sore throat and mouth ulcers.
sore_throat.general_info: Broad-spectrum cationic oral antiseptic providing prolonged bacteriostatic activity by adhering to mucosal surfaces.
precautions: Rinse with 10-15 ml for 30 seconds after brushing, then spit out.
Do not rinse with water or drink immediately after use to allow retention.
Temporary superficial tooth staining can occur with prolonged use (removable by dental cleaning).
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine.
Children under 6 years.
sore_throat.safety_note: Great supportive rinse for inflamed gums, canker sores, and pharyngeal irritation.
sore_throat.dosage_guide: Swish 10ml in mouth for 60 seconds and spit out, twice daily after brushing.

serious: Oral mucosa desquamation if used undiluted for weeks
side_effects.management: Do not rinse with water or drink tea/coffee for 30 minutes following use.

stomach.name: ORS (Oral Rehydration Salts - WHO Formula)
stomach.purpose: Prevents and treats dehydration and electrolyte imbalances resulting from acute diarrhea or vomiting.
stomach.general_info: Scientifically balanced mixture of sodium chloride, anhydrous glucose, potassium chloride, and trisodium citrate conforming to WHO low-osmolarity standards.
precautions: Dissolve entire packet in the exact volume of clean drinking water specified (usually 1 liter or 200 ml).
Do not mix with milk, soup, juice, or soft drinks.
Sip small amounts frequently (5-10 ml every 5 minutes) if vomiting is present.
Discard unused solution after 24 hours at room temperature.
avoid_if: Severe paralytic ileus or intractable mechanical intestinal obstruction.
Severe hypovolemic shock requiring emergency IV resuscitation.
stomach.safety_note: The single most critical life-saving supportive treatment for acute gastrointestinal fluid loss.
stomach.dosage_guide: Mix 1 packet in exactly 1000ml clean water. Drink after every loose stool.

serious: Swelling of eyelids if mixed in too little water
side_effects.management: Always dissolve in the full 1 liter volume. Discard any unused solution after 24 hours.

stomach.name: Liquid Antacid (Magnesium + Aluminum Hydroxide + Simethicone)
stomach.purpose: Rapidly neutralizes excess stomach acid, coats esophageal lining, and disperses trapped gas bubbles.
stomach.general_info: Balanced fast-acting oral suspension that combines acid neutralization with anti-foaming simethicone for heartburn and gas.
precautions: Shake bottle well before pouring.
Take 1 to 2 hours after meals or at bedtime as directed.
Separate administration by at least 2 hours from other medications to avoid drug binding.
avoid_if: Severe kidney failure (risk of aluminum/magnesium systemic accumulation).
Severe acute undiagnosed abdominal pain.
stomach.safety_note: Provides quick symptomatic relief for episodic acidity, sour burps, and gastric fullness.
stomach.dosage_guide: 1-2 teaspoons (5-10ml) 15-30 minutes after meals and at bedtime.

common: Mild constipation (from aluminum) or loose stools (from magnesium)
serious: Electrolyte imbalances if used chronically with kidney disease
side_effects.management: Shake bottle well before pouring. Leave a 2-hour gap before taking other prescription medications.

stomach.name: Chewable Calcium Carbonate / Sodium Bicarbonate
stomach.purpose: Instant fast-acting neutralization of acid reflux, burning sensation, and indigestion.
stomach.general_info: Chewable effervescent or mint tablets that react instantly with hydrochloric acid in the stomach.
precautions: Chew tablets thoroughly before swallowing; follow with a glass of water.
Do not exceed recommended maximum daily tablets.
avoid_if: Hypercalcemia, kidney stones, or severe renal impairment.
Strict low-sodium diets (for sodium bicarbonate formulations).
stomach.safety_note: Ideal for fast portable relief after heavy, spicy, or greasy meals.
stomach.dosage_guide: Dissolve 1 sachet in a glass of water, or chew 1-2 tablets during acute acidity.

side_effects.management: Use for occasional breakthrough acidity. Patients on low-sodium diets should avoid sodium bicarbonate.

stomach.name: Omeprazole (20mg OTC)
stomach.purpose: Provides 24-hour relief from persistent acid reflux, heartburn, and gastroesophageal discomfort.
stomach.general_info: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that suppresses the final step of gastric acid production at the parietal cell proton pump.
precautions: Take once daily in the morning, ideally 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.
Swallow capsules whole with water; do not crush, chew, or open pellets.
Designed for short 14-day courses for frequent heartburn (2 or more days a week).
avoid_if: Severe hepatic failure without physician monitoring.
Known hypersensitivity to omeprazole or other PPIs.
Immediate relief needed (takes 1-4 days for peak effect; use antacid for instant relief).
stomach.safety_note: Consult a gastroenterologist if heartburn persists beyond 14 days or is accompanied by difficulty swallowing.
stomach.dosage_guide: Adults: 20mg once daily in the morning, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.

serious: Bone density reduction with chronic year-long use
side_effects.management: Swallow capsule whole with water. Do not crush or chew. Limit OTC self-treatment to 14 days.

stomach.name: Famotidine (20mg)
stomach.purpose: Prevents and relieves heartburn, acid indigestion, and sour stomach with 10-12 hour acid suppression.
stomach.general_info: H2-receptor antagonist that blocks histamine-stimulated gastric acid secretion, offering longer action than antacids.
precautions: Take 30 to 60 minutes before consuming food or beverages that cause heartburn.
Can be taken with or without food.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to famotidine or other H2 blockers.
Severe renal insufficiency unless dose adjusted by doctor.
stomach.safety_note: Effective for preventing nocturnal acid breakthrough and meal-induced reflux.
stomach.dosage_guide: Adults: 10mg - 20mg once or twice daily, 15 to 60 minutes before meals or at bedtime.

serious: Confusion in elderly with renal failure
side_effects.management: Fast onset within 1 hour. Ideal for meal-triggered or nighttime heartburn.

stomach.name: Loperamide (2mg)
stomach.purpose: Slows intestinal transit to decrease stool frequency and firm up consistency in acute uncomplicated watery diarrhea.
stomach.general_info: Synthetic opioid-receptor agonist acting locally on the myenteric plexus of the large intestine without central narcotic effects.
precautions: Take initial 2 capsules (4mg), followed by 1 capsule (2mg) after each unformed stool (max 8mg/day for OTC use).
Always continue drinking ORS and fluids; loperamide stops frequency but does not replace lost fluids.
Discontinue as soon as stools become formed or if no improvement occurs within 48 hours.
avoid_if: Bloody diarrhea, high fever, or dysentery (STRICT CONTRAINDICATION: risk of toxic megacolon).
Acute ulcerative colitis or bacterial enterocolitis (Salmonella, Shigella, C. difficile).
Children under 12 years without pediatrician direction.
stomach.safety_note: Do not use if stool contains blood, pus, or if diarrhea is accompanied by high fever.
stomach.dosage_guide: Adults: 4mg initially, then 2mg after each unformed stool. Max 8mg/day OTC.

serious: Toxic megacolon if used with bacterial dysentery
Heart rhythm issues if severely overdosed
side_effects.management: DO NOT USE if diarrhea is accompanied by high fever or bloody stools. Rehydrate aggressively.

stomach.name: Psyllium Husk (Isabgol)
stomach.purpose: Natural bulk-forming dietary fiber for chronic constipation, gentle stool softening, and bowel regularity.
stomach.general_info: Natural soluble fiber derived from Plantago ovata seeds that absorbs water in the colon to form an easily passed soft gel.
precautions: MUST mix 1-2 teaspoons thoroughly in a full glass (250 ml) of water and drink immediately.
Follow with an additional glass of plain water to ensure proper intestinal transit.
Takes 12 to 72 hours for full laxative effect.
avoid_if: Intestinal obstruction, fecal impaction, or difficulty swallowing.
Taking without sufficient water (can swell and cause choking or esophageal blockage).
stomach.safety_note: Safest non-habit-forming long-term natural solution for smooth daily bowel habits.
stomach.dosage_guide: 1 to 2 tablespoons stirred into a large glass of water or milk once daily at night.

serious: Esophageal or bowel obstruction if swallowed without adequate liquid
side_effects.management: CRITICAL: Drink immediately after stirring, followed by a second full glass of water.

stomach.name: Probiotics (Lactobacillus & Saccharomyces boulardii)
stomach.purpose: Replenishes healthy intestinal microflora and accelerates gut recovery during or after diarrhea.
stomach.general_info: Beneficial live microbial strains that compete against harmful pathogens, reinforce mucosal barrier, and synthesize organic acids.
precautions: Take with room temperature water or meals; avoid mixing into boiling hot drinks.
If taking concurrent antibiotics, separate probiotic by at least 2 hours.
avoid_if: Severely immunocompromised patients, central venous lines, or critical ICU illness.
stomach.safety_note: Excellent supportive gut restoration therapy during recovery from gastroenteritis or antibiotic therapy.
stomach.dosage_guide: 1 capsule 1 to 2 times daily with meals or as directed on the label.

common: Mild initial bloating or intestinal gas for 24-48 hours
serious: Systemic infection in severely immunocompromised individuals
side_effects.management: Take consistently with meals. If taking antibiotics, separate by at least 2 hours.

stomach.name: Simethicone (80mg / 125mg)
stomach.purpose: Relieves uncomfortable abdominal bloating, pressure, cramps, and gas fullness.
stomach.general_info: Inert surfactant that reduces surface tension of gas bubbles in the gastrointestinal tract, allowing them to coalesce and pass easily.
precautions: Chew tablets thoroughly after meals and at bedtime.
Safe and not systemically absorbed.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to simethicone.
Suspected bowel perforation or intestinal obstruction.
stomach.safety_note: Completely non-systemic; acts strictly physically within the intestinal lumen.
stomach.dosage_guide: 1 to 2 tablets (80-125mg) chewed thoroughly after meals and at bedtime.

common: Passing of trapped flatus (expected therapeutic effect)
serious: None known; simethicone is biologically inert and not absorbed into bloodstream
side_effects.management: Chew tablets thoroughly before swallowing for optimal bubble-collapsing action.

stomach.name: Dicyclomine / Mebeverine
stomach.purpose: Relieves painful intestinal smooth muscle spasms, IBS cramps, and colicky stomach pain.
stomach.general_info: Directly relaxes visceral smooth muscles of the digestive tract, easing sharp griping abdominal spasms.
precautions: Take 20 to 30 minutes before meals.
May cause mild dry mouth or blurred vision.
avoid_if: Severe paralytic ileus or toxic megacolon.
Glaucoma or myasthenia gravis (for antimuscarinic agents).
stomach.safety_note: Helpful supportive therapy for smooth muscle abdominal cramping.
stomach.dosage_guide: 10mg - 20mg 30 minutes before meals for intestinal colic or spasms.

side_effects.management: Avoid if you have glaucoma or an enlarged prostate. Drink water to alleviate dry mouth.

stomach.name: Milk of Magnesia (Magnesium Hydroxide)
stomach.purpose: Gentle osmotic laxative drawing fluid into the colon for overnight relief of acute constipation.
stomach.general_info: Saline osmotic laxative that causes water retention in the bowel lumen, stimulating peristalsis within 6 to 8 hours.
precautions: Drink a full glass of water with each dose.
Take at bedtime for expected morning bowel movement.
avoid_if: Severe kidney failure or hypermagnesemia.
Undiagnosed acute abdominal pain or suspected appendicitis.
stomach.safety_note: Gentle short-term saline laxative; maintain hydration.
stomach.dosage_guide: 15ml - 30ml with a full glass of water at bedtime for constipation relief.

serious: Hypermagnesemia in patients with severe kidney disease
side_effects.management: Follow dose with a full 250ml glass of water. Works within 30 minutes to 6 hours.

skin.name: Calamine Lotion
skin.purpose: Soothes itching, cools skin, and dries weeping rashes, chickenpox spots, and insect bites.
skin.general_info: Classic topical suspension of zinc oxide and ferric oxide providing mild astringent, antiseptic, and antipruritic cooling action.
precautions: Shake bottle well before applying with clean cotton wool.
For external cutaneous use only; keep away from eyes, mouth, and mucous membranes.
avoid_if: Open, deeply ulcerated, or severely infected wounds.
Known sensitivity to calamine.
skin.safety_note: Extremely safe, gentle anti-itch lotion suitable for both children and adults.
skin.dosage_guide: Shake well and dab onto itchy, irritated, or sunburned skin using cotton wool 2-3 times daily.

side_effects.management: External use only. Avoid applying directly to open oozing cuts or mucous membranes.

skin.name: Clotrimazole 1% Topical Antifungal Cream
skin.purpose: Treats superficial fungal skin infections including ringworm (tinea corporis), athlete's foot, and jock itch.
skin.general_info: Broad-spectrum imidazole antifungal that inhibits fungal ergosterol synthesis, destroying pathogen cell membranes.
precautions: Wash and thoroughly dry the affected area before applying a thin layer twice daily.
Continue application for 1 to 2 weeks after symptoms disappear to prevent fungal recurrence.
Wash hands immediately after application.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to clotrimazole or azole antifungals.
Nail or scalp fungal infections (which require oral antifungal prescription).
skin.safety_note: Keep skin folds dry and clean; avoid sharing towels while treating active fungal infections.
skin.dosage_guide: Clean and dry affected area. Apply a thin film 2 to 3 times daily for 2 to 4 weeks.

common: Slight redness or irritation at application site
serious: Allergic contact dermatitis, blistering, or skin peeling
side_effects.management: Continue applying for 1-2 weeks after symptoms disappear to prevent fungal relapse.

skin.name: Hydrocortisone 1% Topical Cream
skin.purpose: Reduces redness, swelling, and severe itching from eczema, contact dermatitis, and mosquito/insect bites.
skin.general_info: Low-potency topical corticosteroid that suppresses localized inflammatory mediator release and capillary permeability.
precautions: Apply sparingly in a thin film to affected areas once or twice daily.
Do not apply to face, groin, or underarms for longer than 7 days without medical direction.
Do not cover with airtight occlusive dressings unless advised.
avoid_if: Untreated bacterial, fungal, or viral skin infections (such as herpes or cold sores).
Acne vulgaris or rosacea (can worsen condition).
skin.safety_note: Use the lowest amount needed for short durations; consult a dermatologist if rash spreads.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply sparingly in a thin layer to inflamed itchy patch 1 to 2 times daily. Max 7 days.

serious: Skin thinning (atrophy) or stretch marks with chronic overuse
side_effects.management: Never apply to the face, groin, or infected wounds without a dermatologist's clearance.

skin.name: Povidone-Iodine 5% / 10% Ointment (Betadine)
skin.purpose: Broad-spectrum antiseptic preventing infection in minor cuts, scrapes, burns, and abrasions.
skin.general_info: Topical iodophore releasing free elemental iodine to rapidly destroy bacteria, fungi, viruses, and bacterial spores on broken skin.
precautions: Clean wound with sterile saline or water before gently applying ointment.
May cover with a sterile dry gauze bandage.
Stains can be washed from clothing with water.
avoid_if: Known allergy to iodine.
Large deep puncture wounds, animal bites, or serious third-degree burns (require ER care).
Pre-term infants or patients with thyroid disease for large surface area use.
skin.safety_note: The gold standard home first-aid antiseptic for clean minor wound management.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply to clean minor cut, scrape, or burn and cover with sterile dressing 1-2 times daily.

serious: Systemic iodine absorption if applied to massive open wounds
side_effects.management: Staining washes off skin with water. Do not bandage airtight over massive body areas.

skin.name: Silver Sulfadiazine 1% / Burn Relief Cream
skin.purpose: Prevents and treats bacterial colonization in second-degree minor burns and scalds.
skin.general_info: Topical antimicrobial combining antibacterial sulfonamide and oligodynamic silver ions, promoting clean thermal wound healing.
precautions: Immediately cool the burn under cool running tap water for 15-20 minutes before applying cream.
Apply a 1-2 mm thick layer under aseptic precautions.
Reapply every 24 hours after gently washing away old residue.
avoid_if: Known sulfonamide (sulfa) drug hypersensitivity.
Pregnant women near term, nursing mothers, or infants under 2 months.
skin.safety_note: Always cool burns under cold tap water immediately; never apply ice, butter, or toothpaste.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply a 1.5mm layer over superficial clean minor burns 1-2 times daily using sterile gloves.

side_effects.management: Avoid if allergic to sulfa medications. For second/third degree burns, go to hospital immediately.

skin.name: Pure Petroleum Jelly (White Petrolatum)
skin.purpose: Provides intensive occlusive moisture barrier for cracked heels, severely chapped lips, and dry peeling skin.
skin.general_info: Triple-purified, hypoallergenic mineral hydrocarbon that prevents 98% of trans-epidermal water loss, accelerating natural stratum corneum repair.
precautions: Apply generously to clean, slightly damp skin after washing.
For external application only.
avoid_if: Fresh deep puncture wounds or animal bites.
Active active acne on oily facial areas.
skin.safety_note: Hypoallergenic, fragrance-free, and universally safe for sensitive barrier protection.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply liberally to clean dry skin, cracked lips, or minor wounds as needed.

common: Mild pore clogging if applied to acne-prone face
serious: Lipoid pneumonia if inhaled into lungs (never put inside nostrils)
side_effects.management: Clean skin before applying to lock in moisture. Do not apply inside nasal passages.

skin.name: Zinc Oxide 10% - 20% Barrier Cream
skin.purpose: Creates a protective waterproof barrier preventing moisture irritation, diaper rash, and chafing.
skin.general_info: Mineral barrier ointment that repels urine, sweat, and external friction while soothing irritated infant or adult skin folds.
precautions: Clean skin thoroughly and allow to dry completely before applying a thick protective layer.
Reapply after every diaper or pad change.
avoid_if: Known allergy to zinc or mineral oils.
Deep infected weeping lesions.
skin.safety_note: Excellent preventive care for infant diaper rash and adult incontinence dermatitis.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply thick layer over diaper rash or friction chafing after cleaning and drying skin.

side_effects.management: Creates an impenetrable physical shield against urine, feces, and wet friction.

skin.name: Neomycin + Polymyxin B + Bacitracin (Triple Antibiotic Ointment)
skin.purpose: First-aid topical ointment preventing localized surface bacterial infections in minor cuts and scratches.
skin.general_info: Synergistic combination of three antibiotics providing broad-spectrum coverage against Gram-positive and Gram-negative skin bacteria.
precautions: Apply a small pea-sized amount to cleaned wound 1 to 3 times daily.
Discontinue if skin redness, burning, or allergic contact dermatitis occurs.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to neomycin, polymyxin, or bacitracin.
Extensive deep puncture wounds or over large body surfaces.
skin.safety_note: For minor cuts only; not intended for deep animal bites or serious puncture wounds.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply small amount (fingertip) to minor scrape or cut 1 to 3 times daily for up to 7 days.

serious: Neomycin contact allergy causing itchy red weeping rash
side_effects.management: Discontinue immediately if the wound gets redder or itchier after application.

skin.name: Benzoyl Peroxide 2.5% / 5% Gel
skin.purpose: Targets acne-causing Cutibacterium acnes bacteria, clears clogged pores, and reduces mild-to-moderate facial blemishes.
skin.general_info: Topical antibacterial and comedolytic agent that releases oxygen radicals in the sebaceous follicle, killing anaerobic acne bacteria.
precautions: Start with once-daily application at night to test tolerance.
Use sunscreen daily as it can increase UV sensitivity.
Avoid contact with dark fabrics and towels as benzoyl peroxide bleaches colored textiles.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to benzoyl peroxide.
Severely sunburned, broken, or irritated skin.
skin.safety_note: Start with lower 2.5% concentration to minimize skin peeling and dryness.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply thin dab to acne pimples once daily at night. Wash face with gentle cleanser first.

side_effects.management: Start with 2.5% every alternate night. Use non-comedogenic moisturizer and protect pillowcases.

skin.name: Salicylic Acid 2% Ointment / Gel
skin.purpose: Exfoliates dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and softens rough calluses, keratosis, and blackheads.
skin.general_info: Lipophilic beta-hydroxy acid (BHA) that penetrates oily follicles, dissolving intercellular sebum and dead keratinocytes.
precautions: Apply a thin layer to clean skin once or twice daily.
Moisturize well if excessive dryness occurs.
avoid_if: Allergy to salicylates or aspirin.
Children with active viral infections.
skin.safety_note: Gentle keratolytic agent for clearing blackheads and dead surface skin buildup.
skin.dosage_guide: Apply thin layer to rough calluses, blackheads, or scaly patches once daily.

serious: Salicylate toxicity if used over large body surfaces
side_effects.management: Apply only to localized target skin areas. Use sunscreen during the day.

eye_ear.name: Carboxymethylcellulose (CMC 0.5%) Artificial Tears
eye_ear.purpose: Lubricates dry, tired, irritated, burning eyes caused by screen time, dust, dry air, or wind.
eye_ear.general_info: Viscous ophthalmic polymer that mimics natural mucin tears, prolonging tear film breakup time and protecting the corneal surface.
precautions: Instill 1 to 2 drops in the affected eye(s) 3 to 4 times daily or as needed.
Do not touch dropper tip to eyelashes, fingers, or any surface to maintain sterility.
Temporary mild blurring of vision may occur for 1-2 minutes after instillation.
avoid_if: Known allergy to carboxymethylcellulose or ophthalmic excipients.
Eye pain, sudden vision changes, or signs of acute bacterial infection (green/yellow pus discharge - requires ophthalmologist).
eye_ear.safety_note: Safe for long-term daily eye lubrication. Discard open bottle 30 days after first breaking seal.
eye_ear.dosage_guide: Instill 1 to 2 drops in the affected eye(s) 3 to 4 times daily or as needed for dryness.

common: Brief blurred vision for 1-2 minutes after instillation
serious: Eye pain, ongoing redness, or vision changes
side_effects.management: Remove contact lenses before use. Do not touch dropper tip to eyelashes or hands.

eye_ear.name: Olopatadine / Ketotifen 0.025% Eye Drops
eye_ear.purpose: Rapidly relieves itchy, red, watery eyes caused by seasonal pollen, pet dander, or environmental allergies.
eye_ear.general_info: Dual-acting topical mast cell stabilizer and selective H1-antihistamine providing sustained ocular anti-allergic relief.
precautions: Instill 1 drop in affected eye(s) once or twice daily.
Remove soft contact lenses before instilling; wait at least 10 minutes before reinserting.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to olopatadine or ketotifen.
Eye redness caused by viral/bacterial conjunctivitis or foreign body trauma.
eye_ear.safety_note: Targeted relief for allergic pink eye (allergic conjunctivitis).
eye_ear.dosage_guide: 1 drop in each affected eye once or twice daily for allergic itchy eyes.

side_effects.management: Keep eyes closed for 1 minute after drop and press lightly on tear duct to reduce throat drainage.

eye_ear.name: Carbamide Peroxide / Mineral Oil Ear Drops
eye_ear.purpose: Softens hardened, impacted ear wax (cerumen) to facilitate gentle natural expulsion.
eye_ear.general_info: Cerumenolytic solution releasing micro-bubbles of oxygen when in contact with ear wax, breaking it into softer fragments.
precautions: Tilt head sideways, place 3 to 5 drops into ear canal, and keep head tilted for 3 to 5 minutes.
Gently flush with warm water or wipe ear opening with a clean tissue.
NEVER insert cotton buds, hairpins, or sharp objects into the ear canal.
avoid_if: Perforated eardrum, history of tympanoplasty, or active ear discharge/pus.
Ear surgery within the past 6 months.
eye_ear.safety_note: Softens wax safely; never poke cotton buds into the ear canal as they push wax deeper.
eye_ear.dosage_guide: Tilt head sideways. Place 3-5 drops into ear canal twice daily for up to 4 days.

common: Bubbling or crackling sound in ear
Temporary ear fullness as wax expands
serious: Severe ear pain (never use if eardrum is ruptured or punctured)
side_effects.management: Lie on your side for 5 minutes. DO NOT insert cotton buds/Q-tips into the ear canal.

eye_ear.name: Sterile Normal Saline Eye Wash
eye_ear.purpose: Flushes out dust, grit, eyelashes, smoke, or mild irritants from the ocular surface.
eye_ear.general_info: Sterile 0.9% sodium chloride buffered ophthalmic solution for emergency or hygienic eye irrigation.
precautions: Flush eye gently holding eyelids open.
For chemical splashes, continue continuous gentle flushing for 15 minutes and seek immediate emergency ER care.
avoid_if: Penetrating eye injuries or visible eyeball puncture.
eye_ear.safety_note: Keep in first-aid kits for immediate flushing of dust, dirt, or foreign particles.
eye_ear.dosage_guide: Flush eye gently using sterile eye cup or squeeze bottle to rinse out dust or grit.

side_effects.management: If eye pain or foreign body sensation persists after rinsing, consult an ophthalmologist immediately.

allergies.name: Fexofenadine (120mg / 180mg)
allergies.purpose: High-potency non-drowsy relief for acute allergic rhinitis, pollen allergies, and urticaria (hives).
allergies.general_info: Third-generation non-sedating antihistamine that does not cross the blood-brain barrier, ensuring zero daytime drowsiness.
precautions: Take once daily with water.
Avoid taking with fruit juices (grapefruit, orange, apple) as they reduce drug absorption by up to 36%.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to fexofenadine.
Severe renal failure unless dose adjusted by doctor.
allergies.safety_note: Gold standard non-sedating antihistamine for drivers, pilots, and office workers.
allergies.dosage_guide: Adults: 120mg once daily for allergic rhinitis; 180mg for urticaria (hives).

common: Drowsiness (very low compared to older antihistamines)
side_effects.management: Take with plain water. Avoid fruit juices (apple, orange, grapefruit) within 4 hours as they block absorption.

allergies.name: Levocetirizine (5mg)
allergies.purpose: Provides powerful 24-hour relief from intense allergic itching, constant sneezing, and skin wheals.
allergies.general_info: Purified R-enantiomer of cetirizine providing superior receptor affinity with smaller therapeutic dosing.
precautions: Take once daily in the evening or at bedtime.
Avoid alcohol while taking antihistamines.
avoid_if: Severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance < 10 ml/min).
allergies.safety_note: Fast-acting relief for acute allergic skin reactions and seasonal hay fever.
allergies.dosage_guide: Adults: 5mg once daily in the evening with or without food.

side_effects.management: Take at bedtime. Do not drive or drink alcohol until personal response is known.

allergies.name: Dimenhydrinate (50mg)
allergies.purpose: Prevents and treats motion sickness, dizziness, and nausea during road, air, or sea travel.
allergies.general_info: Antiemetic antihistamine with central anticholinergic action reducing vestibular stimulation in the inner ear.
precautions: Take 30 to 60 minutes BEFORE travel begins for maximum prevention.
Causes noticeable drowsiness; do not drive or operate machinery.
avoid_if: Glaucoma or prostatic enlargement.
Concurrent alcohol or sedative intake.
allergies.safety_note: Take prior to journey departure for effective motion sickness prevention.
allergies.dosage_guide: Adults: 50mg to 100mg taken 30 to 60 minutes before travel. Repeat every 4-6 hours. Max 400mg/day.

side_effects.management: DO NOT drive while taking. Take with food or water before embarkation.

allergies.name: Meclizine (25mg)
allergies.purpose: Less-drowsy prevention of motion sickness, travel nausea, and mild positional vertigo.
allergies.general_info: Long-acting antihistaminic antiemetic offering 24-hour vestibular protection with reduced sedation.
precautions: Take 1 hour before travel once daily.
avoid_if: Severe liver dysfunction.
Children under 12 years without doctor advice.
allergies.safety_note: Preferred over dimenhydrinate when less sedation is desired during long journeys.
allergies.dosage_guide: Adults: 25mg to 50mg once daily 1 hour before travel or for vertigo.

serious: Urinary retention, acute narrow-angle glaucoma flare
side_effects.management: Less sedating than dimenhydrinate, but precautions against driving still apply.

muscle_pain.name: Diclofenac Diethylamine 1.16% Topical Gel
muscle_pain.purpose: Relieves localized joint pain, muscular sprains, tendonitis, and lower back stiffness.
muscle_pain.general_info: Targeted transdermal NSAID gel that penetrates deep subcutaneous and joint tissues without high systemic blood levels.
precautions: Gently massage into the affected painful joint or muscle 3 to 4 times daily.
Wash hands thoroughly after application unless treating hand joints.
Do not apply to open cuts, burns, or broken skin.
avoid_if: Known allergy to diclofenac, aspirin, or other NSAIDs.
Third trimester of pregnancy.
muscle_pain.safety_note: Significantly safer on the stomach than oral painkillers while providing direct localized joint relief.
muscle_pain.dosage_guide: Apply 2g to 4g gently over the painful joint or muscle 3 to 4 times daily.

common: Dryness or tingling at application site
serious: Systemic NSAID side effects if applied over huge body areas
side_effects.management: Wash hands immediately after rubbing in. Do not apply under airtight heat wraps or to broken skin.

muscle_pain.name: Methyl Salicylate & Menthol Liniment / Spray
muscle_pain.purpose: Produces soothing counter-irritant warmth and improves local blood flow for sore muscles and stiff joints.
muscle_pain.general_info: Topical rubefacient producing warm soothing sensations that distract brain pain sensors and relax tight muscle fibers.
precautions: Apply to intact painful areas up to 3-4 times daily.
Do NOT apply a heating pad immediately over freshly applied menthol liniment (risk of skin blistering).
avoid_if: Broken, inflamed, or raw skin.
Children under 12 years.
Known salicylate allergy.
muscle_pain.safety_note: Great for post-workout muscle soreness, neck stiffness, and non-traumatic sprains.
muscle_pain.dosage_guide: Spray from 5cm distance onto painful area 2 to 3 times daily. Do not massage aggressively.

serious: Chemical burns if covered with tight heating pads
side_effects.management: Never apply a heating pad over methyl salicylate. Keep away from eyes and broken skin.

muscle_pain.name: Cryotherapy Cold Gel Ice Pack
muscle_pain.purpose: Reduces acute swelling, localized internal bleeding, and throbbing pain in fresh sprains and bruises.
muscle_pain.general_info: Non-pharmacological cold application causing local vasoconstriction, reducing edema and numbing sensory nerve endings within the first 48 hours.
precautions: Wrap the ice pack in a thin towel; NEVER apply bare ice directly onto skin (prevents ice burns/frostbite).
Apply for 15 to 20 minutes at a time, allowing skin to warm back up between sessions.
Follow the R.I.C.E. protocol: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.
avoid_if: Raynaud's phenomenon, cold urticaria, or severe peripheral vascular disease.
muscle_pain.safety_note: The mandatory first-line therapy for acute sports injuries and ankle sprains in the first 48 hours.
muscle_pain.dosage_guide: Wrap cold pack in a thin towel and apply to sprain/strain for 15-20 minutes every 2-3 hours.

serious: Frostbite or ice burn if applied directly to bare skin without towel barrier
side_effects.management: NEVER place frozen pack directly on bare skin. Limit each session to maximum 20 minutes.

muscle_pain.name: Thermotherapy Hot Pack / Heating Pad
muscle_pain.purpose: Relieves chronic lower back stiffness, menstrual cramps, and persistent tight muscle spasms.
muscle_pain.general_info: Therapeutic heat application promoting vasodilation, increasing oxygenated blood flow, and relaxing contracted myofascial bands.
precautions: Apply for 15 to 20 minutes with a protective fabric layer.
Do NOT sleep on an active electric heating pad to avoid accidental burns.
Do not use on fresh acute injuries (under 48 hours) where heat worsens inflammatory swelling.
avoid_if: Acute traumatic injuries with active swelling.
Areas of sensory nerve loss or diabetic neuropathy.
muscle_pain.safety_note: Use heat for chronic stiffness and tight muscles; use ice for acute sprains.
muscle_pain.dosage_guide: Apply comfortably warm pack to chronic stiff muscles for 15 to 20 minutes.

serious: Thermal skin burns if set too hot or if falling asleep on pad
side_effects.management: Never sleep on an active heating pad. Do not apply heat to acute fresh injuries under 48 hours.

muscle_pain.name: Elastic Compression Crepe Bandage
muscle_pain.purpose: Provides stable mechanical joint support and limits inflammatory edema in sprained wrists, knees, or ankles.
muscle_pain.general_info: High-elastic woven cotton compression wrap designed to stabilize vulnerable ligaments without immobilizing joints completely.
precautions: Wrap firmly in a figure-eight pattern starting from distal to proximal.
Do NOT wrap too tightly (check that toes/fingers stay warm, pink, and free of tingling).
Remove bandage before sleeping to allow normal circulation.
avoid_if: Known deep vein thrombosis (DVT) without vascular consultation.
muscle_pain.safety_note: Loosen immediately if numbness, pins-and-needles, or cold blueness appears in fingers or toes.
muscle_pain.dosage_guide: Wrap firmly with 50% overlap from fingers/toes upwards. Loosen before sleeping.

serious: Circulation cut-off (numbness, tingling, pale or blue cold toes/fingers) if wrapped too tight
side_effects.management: If toes or fingers become numb, tingly, cold, or pale, unwrap and re-wrap more loosely immediately.

general.name: Paracetamol (500mg)
general.purpose: Reliable first-line remedy for general body ache, mild viral malaise, and elevated body temperature.
general.general_info: Standard over-the-counter analgesic and antipyretic suitable for universal supportive comfort.
precautions: Do not exceed packaging adult limits (max 4000 mg/day).
Maintain 4-6 hours between doses.
avoid_if: Severe liver dysfunction or chronic heavy alcoholism.
general.safety_note: A safe, dependable essential medicine for general home first-aid kits.
general.dosage_guide: Adults: 500mg every 4-6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 4000mg per day.

serious: Liver damage if combined with alcohol or exceeding max daily dose
side_effects.management: Check all cold medication packaging to ensure you aren't doubling up on paracetamol.

general.name: ORS (Oral Rehydration Salts)
general.purpose: Restores vital electrolyte balance and cellular hydration during exhaustion, heat stress, or mild illness.
general.general_info: WHO-standard electrolyte restoration formula that maintains intravascular volume and cellular energy.
precautions: Mix with clean drinking water as directed.
Sip steadily across the day.
avoid_if: Severe circulatory shock requiring emergency IV fluids.
general.safety_note: Indispensable supportive recovery measure for hot summer days, physical fatigue, and illness.
general.dosage_guide: Ready-to-drink or mix as directed. Sip frequently during exercise, heat exhaustion, or illness.

serious: Excess sodium in severe kidney disease
side_effects.management: Ideal for replenishing minerals during hot summer days and routine rehydration.

general.name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid 500mg Chewable)
general.purpose: Essential water-soluble antioxidant supporting immune phagocyte activity, cellular defense, and collagen synthesis.
general.general_info: Daily antioxidant nutritional supplement supporting epithelial barrier integrity and cellular defense mechanisms.
precautions: Chew 1 tablet daily with or after meals.
Excess intake is safely excreted in urine, but very high doses can cause mild gastric acidity.
avoid_if: History of recurrent calcium oxalate kidney stones.
Hemochromatosis (iron overload disorder).
general.safety_note: Widely used immune support during recovery from seasonal viral infections.

side_effects.management: Chew after a meal. Water-soluble vitamin; excess is safely excreted in urine.

general.name: Zinc Sulfate / Gluconate (20mg - 50mg)
general.purpose: Crucial trace mineral supporting T-lymphocyte function, wound healing, and respiratory mucosal integrity.
general.general_info: Essential trace element required for over 300 metalloenzymes controlling DNA synthesis and infection resistance.
precautions: Always take with a meal to prevent nausea.
Do not combine with oral antibiotics (such as ciprofloxacin or doxycycline) at the same time; separate by 2 hours.
avoid_if: Known hypersensitivity to zinc salts.
general.safety_note: Shown in clinical studies to help shorten the duration and severity of common colds when taken early.
general.dosage_guide: Adults: 1 tablet daily with a substantial meal. Do not take on an empty stomach.

common: Nausea or metallic taste if taken on empty stomach
serious: Copper deficiency and anemia with chronic months of high-dose zinc
side_effects.management: Always ingest in the middle of a full meal to completely avoid the classic zinc nausea.

general.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol 1000 IU / 60,000 IU)
general.purpose: Maintains calcium homeostasis, bone density, muscle strength, and modulates adaptive immune responses.
general.general_info: Fat-soluble secosteroid hormone synthesized in skin on sunlight exposure, critical for skeletal and systemic immune health.
precautions: Take with a meal containing dietary fats for optimal intestinal absorption.
For 60,000 IU high-dose capsules, take strictly on a weekly basis as advised.
avoid_if: Hypercalcemia, hypervitaminosis D, or severe metastatic calcification.
general.safety_note: A vital health supplement for individuals with limited sun exposure or indoor lifestyles.
general.dosage_guide: 60,000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks (deficiency), or 1000-2000 IU daily with a fatty meal.

serious: Hypercalcemia (nausea, weakness, confusion, kidney stones) with massive chronic overdose
side_effects.management: Vitamin D is fat-soluble. Take with milk, yogurt, or main meal for optimal absorption.

general.name: Vitamin B-Complex with Methylcobalamin (B12)

common: Mild temporary tackiness before fully absorbed

Active eczema flares or sunburned facial skin.

side_effects.management: Limit use to 2 nights weekly initially. Use a ceramide moisturizer to prevent excessive dryness.

Pregnancy or breastfeeding without physician clearance.

serious: Paradoxical hyperpigmentation if exposed to heavy sun without sunscreen
side_effects.management: Wear broad-spectrum sunscreen religiously every single day during and after treatment.

Acute rosacea or active dermatitis flare-ups.

serious: Severe dermatitis or chemical burn if used on wet skin or combined with AHAs/BHAs
side_effects.management: Wait 15 minutes after washing face until skin is bone-dry before applying. Use ceramide cream generously.

Non-comedogenic and fragrance-free.

Requires evening cleansing to wash off completely

side_effects.management: Wash face at night with a gentle foaming cleanser to keep pores clear.
